description: Phase 44 — Adaptive Position Sizing, Bayesian Agent Weights & Pipeline Wiring. Wire Phase 43 modules (RegimeDetector, AdaptiveExitManager, ConfidenceCalibration) into the live trading pipeline. Add two new production modules: adaptive position sizing (fractional Kelly + confidence-weighted sigmoid + drawdown-recovery + regime multipliers) and Bayesian agent weight updating (Thompson Sampling with regime-conditional Beta distributions). Delivered: 2 new production modules + 3 pipeline integration edits + 209 tests.

userStories.title: Adaptive Position Sizing with Fractional Kelly + Confidence-Weighted Sigmoid
userStories.description: New src/scanner/adaptive_position_sizing.py implementing: (1) Fractional Kelly Criterion (K% = (W*R-L)/R * fraction, fraction=0.25-0.33), (2) Confidence-weighted sigmoid mapping (σ(x) = 1/(1+e^(-k*(x-0.5))), k=4), (3) Drawdown-recovery sizing (recovery_factor = max(0.3, 1 - dd/max_dd)), (4) Regime-dependent multipliers (LOW=1.3, NORMAL=1.0, HIGH=0.65, EXTREME=0.40), (5) Composite sizing combining all four signals with configurable weights.
acceptanceCriteria: AdaptivePositionSizer class with calculate_size() method
Fractional Kelly with configurable fraction (default 0.33) and rolling window
Confidence-weighted sigmoid with configurable steepness parameter k
Drawdown-recovery factor with configurable max_acceptable_drawdown and floor
Regime-dependent multipliers with configurable per-regime values
Composite sizing combining Kelly, confidence, drawdown, and regime signals
Pure Python + numpy only, no heavy dependencies
At least 40 unit tests covering all sizing strategies and edge cases
userStories.notes: 84 tests passing. 627-line module with 5 sizing strategies: fractional Kelly, confidence sigmoid, drawdown recovery, regime multipliers, composite. 3 factory functions (default/conservative/aggressive). Atomic JSON persistence.

userStories.title: Bayesian Agent Weight Updater with Thompson Sampling
userStories.description: New src/scanner/bayesian_agent_weights.py implementing: (1) Thompson Sampling with Beta(α,β) per agent (12 agents), (2) Regime-conditional variant with separate Beta per agent per regime (12*4=48 distributions), (3) Epsilon-decay exploration (ε₀=0.15, decay=0.9995, min=0.02), (4) Online Bayesian update: win→α+=1, loss→β+=1 with optional decay factor, (5) Weight sampling and normalization for agent team evaluation.
acceptanceCriteria: BayesianAgentWeights class with sample_weights() and update() methods
Beta(α,β) distribution per agent with configurable priors
Regime-conditional variant: separate Beta per agent per regime
Epsilon-decay exploration with configurable parameters
Bayesian weight decay for non-stationarity (multiply α,β by decay factor periodically)
Atomic JSON persistence with .tmp + os.rename()
At least 35 unit tests covering sampling, updating, regime conditioning, and persistence
userStories.notes: 65 tests passing. 554-line module with Thompson Sampling (48 Beta distributions: 12 agents × 4 regimes), epsilon-decay exploration, partial credit updates, weight decay. 3 factory functions. Atomic JSON persistence.
